capturePolicy: Native Windows screenshots from real executions using synthetic data. Do not represent seeded conversations, mock results or settings screens as completed agent workflows.

scenarios.prompt: Create a polished Excel balance sheet for Northstar Studio using synthetic figures: cash 68000, receivables 22000, equipment 45000, payables 15000, loan 40000, equity 80000. Use formulas for totals and a balance check. Save the XLSX and show its preview.
scenarios.evidence: Successful OfficeCLI tool result, saved XLSX, visible formatted worksheet, balanced totals.

scenarios.prompt: Create a polished two-page PDF executive brief for Northstar Studio. Q1 revenue was 146000 and costs were 85500. Include a summary, a financial table and three recommended next steps. Use synthetic data and open the saved PDF preview.
scenarios.evidence: Successful PDF tool result, saved PDF, rendered pages.

scenarios.prompt: Create a five-slide PowerPoint for Northstar Studio's Q1 review. Use synthetic data: revenue 146000, costs 85500, profit 60500. Include an overview, results, priorities, risks and next steps. Save the PPTX and show the preview.
scenarios.evidence: Successful OfficeCLI result, saved PPTX with five slides, preview.

scenarios.prompt: Create a Word project proposal for Northstar Studio with scope, three milestones, deliverables and a budget table. Clearly label the example data as synthetic. Save the DOCX and show its preview.
scenarios.evidence: Successful OfficeCLI result, saved DOCX and preview.

scenarios.prompt: Organize only the supplied demonstration inbox into data, briefs and src folders. Preserve all contents, then list the resulting structure.
scenarios.evidence: Real file operations, before/after paths, preserved content hashes.

scenarios.prompt: In the demonstration workspace, add validation to totals.js, write a focused Node test, and run it using the terminal. Do not install dependencies or modify any files outside this workspace.
scenarios.evidence: Saved code diff, actual terminal command and successful exit status.

scenarios.prompt: Create an interactive Q1 dashboard artifact for Northstar Studio, then revise it to add a quarterly goal progress indicator. Use synthetic data.
scenarios.evidence: Working preview and two revisions of the same artifact identity.

scenarios.prompt: Use the embedded browser to open https://example.com and inspect its heading. Do not use web search as a substitute.
scenarios.evidence: Embedded browser page and successful browser inspection.

scenarios.prompt: In plan mode, propose a three-step plan for a Northstar Studio dashboard. Ask one clarifying question if useful. Wait for the UI approval before creating or changing files.
scenarios.evidence: Pending approval button and no mutations before approval; progress after approval.

scenarios.prompt: Use a team to review the demonstration dashboard: one member reviews accessibility and another reviews data calculations. Collect their findings without changing files.
scenarios.evidence: Actual member runs, per-member progress and collected findings.

scenarios.prompt: Create a one-time local demonstration reminder to review the Northstar dashboard. Keep it in this demo profile and do not message external services.
scenarios.evidence: Saved schedule and actual local execution history.

scenarios.prompt: Remember that this demonstration workspace uses the fictional company Northstar Studio. Then retrieve that saved preference.
scenarios.evidence: Persistent memory write and subsequent retrieval in the demo profile.
